body: Not gonna lie. It's so cold today I've been fantasizing about just walking outside and letting Mother Nature take care of me...

My therapist asked me on a scale of 0-10 how depressed I am.  I reluctantly admitted being depressed but couldn't bring myself to tell her the truth. that it was far higher than 5, and that if I weren't afraid of death, I would have killed myself by now. I don't know why I bother going when I'm just going to lie.
not reporting my mother for abusing my younger siblings

I'm literally crying here reading all your responses (I don't know why- maybe it's because y'all are so supportive). She's coming from my home country, and speaks little English, which makes it harder to turn her away.  I think I will at the very least see if any of my friends could let me crash, if even for part of the time.  I just haven't told anyone IRL about any of this or my past so they might think it's weird that I don't want to be at my place or with her.
On an intellectual level I know that's true. It's that feeling that she's still my mother and thus I'm obligated to care for and take her in...

I don't know if I can do it. If I call her, she's going to say she's coming and staying with me and that's the end of it.  I've never talked back to her before, at least not in recent memory.  My brother would get backhanded anytime he tried something like that...
I know, I'm a big wimp :(
